basic_details.job_title: CUTN Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN) has notified 1 vacancy for the Field Investigator post on a contract basis. The engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis, with an initial appointment for 3 months that may be extended. The candidate must possess a 4-Year UG in Music or 2-Year PG in Music from a recognised University with a minimum of 55% marks, along with the ability to communicate effectively in Tamil and English and knowledge of computers. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUTN Field Investigator
content_sections.text: Prepare your application in the prescribed format along with a cover letter and a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Obtain scanned copies of relevant certificates and mark sheets. Send your completed application and scanned documents to the email ID: [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the specified email on or before 15th October, 2026, 6 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email, along with meeting details, to attend the online or offline interview. The selection will be based on performance in the interview, academic credentials, and the needs of the project. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. For online interviews, a Google Meet link will be sent to the respective email addresses of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Field Investigator post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary and on a contract basis, with an initial appointment for 3 months that may be extended till the required amount of data is met and the work is completed.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and is there any relaxation mentioned?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be more than 50 years of age. The notification does not mention any category-wise age relaxations.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email along with meeting details to attend either an online or offline interview based on their performance, academic credentials, and project needs.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the shortlist and interview details appear?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will receive meeting details and links directly via their respective email addresses.

faq.question: Q5. What documents are required to be attached with the application email?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach a cover letter, a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), and scanned copies of relevant certificates and mark sheets.
